description: Test cases for decodeQuotedPrintable function with UTF-8 characters

testCases.name: Copyright symbol in text
testCases.description: Copyright symbol (U+00A9) encoded as =C2=A9 in quoted-printable

testCases.name: Mixed content with copyright
testCases.description: Copyright symbol mixed with regular text

testCases.name: Multiple special characters
testCases.description: Multiple UTF-8 characters: copyright, registered, trademark

testCases.name: Email footer with copyright
testCases.input:
Thank you,
Twitch

=C2=A9 2025 Twitch Interactive, Inc.
testCases.expected:
Thank you,
Twitch

© 2025 Twitch Interactive, Inc.
testCases.description: Email footer format with copyright symbol

testCases.name: Soft line breaks
testCases.input:
Long line with =C2=A9 symbol=
continues here

testCases.name: Plain text without encoding
testCases.description: Regular text should pass through unchanged

testCases.name: Em dash and en dash
testCases.description: Em dash (—) and en dash (–) characters

testCases.name: Quotes and apostrophes
testCases.description: Smart quotes and apostrophes (U+201C, U+201D, U+2018, U+2019)

testCases.name: Real email content example
testCases.input:
If you have any questions or concerns, contact Twitch Customer Support.
=C2=A9 2025 Twitch
testCases.expected:
If you have any questions or concerns, contact Twitch Customer Support.
© 2025 Twitch
testCases.description: Simulated real email content with copyright

testCases.name: Invalid hex sequence
testCases.description: Invalid hex sequences should be left as-is

testCases.name: Empty string
testCases.description: Empty string should return empty string
